outline: The purpose of the course is to discuss the e-business management. The contents of this course will include: 1. General concept of e-business management, 2. E-Marketplaces, 3. Retailing in Electronic Commerce, 4.B2BE-Commerce & e-SCM, 5.Innovative EC Systems, 6. e-Payment, e-Order, eCRM, 7.E-Commerce Strategy,8.Case Study.
schedule:
Week 1 Overview of Electronic Commerce
Week 2 E-Marketplaces: Structures, Mechanisms, Economics, and Impacts
Week 3 Retailing in Electronic Commerce: Products and Services; Consumer Behavior, Market Research, and Advertisement
Week4 B2BE-Commerce: Selling and Buying in Private E-Markets
Week5 E-Supply Chains, Collaborative Commerce, and Corporate Portals
Week6 Innovative EC Systems: From E-Government and E-Learning to Consumer-to-Consumer Commerce
Week7 Electronic Payment Systems(Projects reporting - 1)
Week8 Order Fulfillment, eCRM,and Other Support Services
(Projects reporting - 2)
Week9 Midterm (Projects reporting - 3)
Week10~13 Case Study
Week14 E-Commerce Strategy and Global EC
Economics and Justification of Electronic Commerce
Week15 Launching a Successful Online Business and EC Projects
Legal, Ethical, and Compliance Issues in EC
Week 16 Final Projects report - 1
Week 17 Final Projects report - 2
Week 18 Final Exam (Final Projects report - 3)
